name: Skill Search
description: Search upstream skill repositories and install vetted skills with trusted-source provenance and community approval.

tools.name: skill_search
tools.title: Search Skills
tools.description: Search upstream skill repositories with an isolated no-tools discovery reviewer and return a ranked shortlist for the agent to choose from.
promptGuidelines: Call with the capability intent and relevant task context before inventing a recurring workflow skill.
The tool performs upstream search, host-controlled preview fetching, and isolated no-tools discovery review; it returns a ranked shortlist, not a user decision.
Read the shortlist, choose the best candidate yourself, and call skill_install with that candidateId. Do not ask the user to pick from the list.

intent.description: Capability, workflow, or product context the agent needs a skill for.

context.description: Optional task context that helps the isolated discovery reviewer judge fit.

tools.name: skill_preview
tools.title: Preview Skill
tools.description: Fetch and vet one skill candidate for body and risk inspection without installing it.
promptGuidelines: Preview does not install. Use skill_install to perform the enforced vetting, approval, and install path.

tools.name: skill_install
tools.title: Install Skill
tools.description: Fetch, vet, and install the selected upstream skill. Trusted sources install directly; community sources trigger host approval.
promptGuidelines: Call only after you have selected the best candidate from skill_search results.
Do not ask the user to choose a skill or to approve in chat. Community approvals are handled by the host approval shelf.

candidateId.description: Candidate id returned by skill_search after the agent selected the best fit.

settingsComponent.label: Skill Search
settingsComponent.description: Upstream skill search, vetting, and installed skill provenance.
